summary: This project provides a Lean4 formalization of the Graded Rewriting Homology (GRH) verification, offering a compact implementation that can be run via CLI or the Lean4 REPL. It builds on the Lean4 ecosystem and demonstrates a fast simple proof time of 0.86 ms. Researchers or mathematicians needing a succinct Lean4 proof of GRH may find it useful, especially for exploring formal verification workflows. Its main strength is the concise code size and speed, while its primary drawback is its very recent release and limited community adoption.
